interactions.summary: After another student affirms the filter model, Jiang attacks the New Yorker as the emblem of technically polished but spiritually empty writing that achieves prestige without world-changing force.
A student reads Canto 17's transition out of the mist into fantasy, where Dante asks what moves imagination when the senses do not.
Jiang frames the passage by insisting Dante's visions are sent to him rather than self-generated.

claims.claim: The student synthesis keeps Jiang's framework intact by treating bad writing as the writer's own biases and experience clouding a deeper structure that might otherwise come through.
Jiang lets the class name talent and perseverance, but the student's formulation keeps divine invitation or filter-structure as the main reason some writers are better channels than others.
Jiang defines the New Yorker as bad writing because it can spend decades perfecting stylish language and theory while still signifying nothing.
The Canto 17 reading presents imagination as something moved by heavenly light or divine will rather than by ordinary sensory input.
claims.temporal_scope: Quoted Dante passage read in lecture on 2026-06-26.

claims.claim: Jiang's immediate gloss is that Dante's visions arrive from above and are not under his personal control.

signature_moments.moment: Prestige prose can be beautiful word after word and still mean nothing.
signature_moments.source_phrase: beautiful word after word after word signifying nothing
signature_moments.why_it_matters: Jiang gives a memorable negative criterion for bad writing: polish without revelation or consequence.

signature_moments.moment: Dante's visions are not self-made fantasies but transmissions sent down to him.
signature_moments.source_phrase: These are just visions that are sent down to him
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It bridges the writer-channel discussion into Dante's own imagination as a receptive medium rather than autonomous creativity.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's phrase for imaginal content that descends from beyond the self instead of being willed by the thinker.

chronology_notes.note: On June 26 Jiang moves directly from a polemic against prestige writing to Dante's divinely sent fantasy, tightening the contrast between empty polish and genuine revelatory vision.
